collection.description: Two friends remember the day they first met.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend1) and (friend2), two friends, remember the day they first met.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The friends enjoy a quiet reunion.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The familiar path looks different after many years.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Each makes something the other genuinely likes.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The gathering becomes a cheerful reunion.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The friends miss private conversation and slip away briefly.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They share lunch as they always do.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One friend secretly appreciates the lack of ceremony.
